Welcome to The Equine Institute!
We are passionate about HELPING HORSES through educating and empowering their people!

Developed by highly sought after practicing equine veterinarians and physiotherapists, our science-based courses empower you to confidently care for your horse, from first aid, anatomy and nutrition, to professional-level courses.

We offer NBCAAM and RACE approved continuing education and online horse health education courses great for all horse owners.
